script_text: Pisces — Neptune is stirring your world in ways you cannot ignore this week. Monday through Wednesday, Mercury sextiles your ruling planet Neptune, activating your 12th House of intuition and subconscious breakthroughs, but a sharp square to Mars in your 10th House means career tensions peak late Monday — avoid heated confrontations at work that day. The turning point arrives Thursday when Venus trines Jupiter in your 4th House, opening emotional doors and bringing a financial breeze from an unexpected source tied to family or real estate matters. Friday through Sunday glows beautifully as the Sun enters your 7th House, and single Pisces stars may meet someone aligned with your soul purpose, especially Saturday evening under the waxing moon. Your power day is Thursday when Venus-Jupiter creates real material and emotional abundance, while Monday carries the risk of workplace friction under Mars square Sun. Lean into your water-sign gifts this week — journal your dreams Tuesday night for a revelation. Follow for daily updates.
